title: PortfolioHistoryRequest
description: Live-account-view input. The tenant-dashboard BFF dispatches this to exec-svc's portfolio_history Activity (via the PortfolioHistoryWorkflow on broker-<broker_target>) to read the brokerage account's Alpaca /v2/account/portfolio/history series for the dashboard /live equity chart. READ-ONLY: a GET of account history places no orders. period/timeframe are ALREADY RESOLVED by the BFF client (the range->period/timeframe mapping, incl. the YTD days-since-Jan-1 calc, happens BEFORE this request is built) so the workflow/activity stay a dumb, replay-stable pass-through (never a clock read, never the word YTD). Equity is account-level — shared by every tenant routing to a given broker_target — so the request is keyed solely on broker_target.

broker_target.description: Routes the portfolio-history Activity to the broker-<value> task queue, mirroring AccountSnapshotRequest.broker_target.

period.description: ALREADY-RESOLVED Alpaca period, e.g. 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, 1A, or a YTD-derived <N>D. The BFF client resolves the dashboard range into this; the workflow/activity never interpret it.

timeframe.description: ALREADY-RESOLVED Alpaca timeframe, e.g. 5Min, 15Min, 1D. Resolved alongside period by the BFF client.

tenant_id.description: OPTIONAL. When present, exec resolves the broker for this tenant so the chart reads the tenant's OWN brokerage account (per-tenant-credential end-state). When absent (the account-level dashboard caller, or a legacy request), exec falls back to the account-level credential set. Behavior-preserving under the env-fallback source (which ignores tenant → the same single account). Mirrors AccountSnapshotRequest.tenant_id.
